spans.text: The Clergy of the Red Hand serve the tenants Harros represents, attempting to uphold justice, protect the weak, and enforce the word of law. Those who act as Harros’ clerics and paladins are referred to collectively as Dawnwatchers, who always look toward the rising sun that cuts through the darkness of night. The Red Hand are closely associated with the Lion’s Council and the forces of the Land Away, where they work very closely with the dragonkin Dimanistar clan to protect Harros’ temple.
